Write src/lib/supabase.js: import createClient from @supabase/supabase-js. Declare SUPABASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_KEY = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY. Export useMock = !SUPABASE_URL || SUPABASE_URL === 'your-supabase-url' || !SUPABASE_KEY || SUPABASE_KEY === 'your-supabase-anon-key'. Export supabase = useMock ? null : createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY).

Write src/lib/mock.js: export mockSuppliers array (4 entries: id, name, contact_name, phone, email, address). Export mockCustomers array (5 entries: id, name, phone, email, notes). Export mockProducts array (25 entries total): 10 vet drugs (Oxytetracycline 20% Injection, Ivermectin 1% Injection, Ampicillin 250mg Capsules, Vitamin B-Complex Injection, Albendazole Oral Suspension, Gentamicin 10% Injection, Enrofloxacin 10% Oral Solution, Newcastle Disease Vaccine, Multivitamin Poultry Supplement, Penicillin G Procaine Injection) with sku VD-001 to VD-010; 8 agro chemicals (Glyphosate 360g/L Herbicide, Cypermethrin 10EC Insecticide, Emamectin Benzoate 5% WG, Carbendazim 50WP Fungicide, Lambda-cyhalothrin 2.5EC, NPK 15-15-15 Fertilizer, Urea 46% Fertilizer, Calcium Ammonium Nitrate) with sku AC-001 to AC-008; 4 equipment (Motorized Knapsack Sprayer, Hand Pump Sprayer 16L, Digital Weighing Scale 50kg, Animal Ear Tag Applicator) with sku EQ-001 to EQ-004; 3 consumables (Disposable Syringes 5ml, Examination Gloves Medium, Cattle Ear Tags Pack) with sku CO-001 to CO-003. Every product has: id, name, category, sub_category, sku, unit, pack_size, quantity (random 5-200), reorder_level (10-30), cost_price, selling_price, supplier_id, batch_number (BAT-YYYY-NNN format), expiry_date (2025-2027), notes. Export mockSales (15 entries with id, receipt_id RCPT-20240115-0001 to 0015, customer_name, payment_method, total, discount, user_id demo-admin, status completed, created_at dates in Jan-Mar 2024). Export mockSaleItems (each sale has 2-4 items with product_id, product_name, quantity, unit_price, total). Export mockPurchases (8 entries with id, po_number PO-2024-001 to 008, supplier_id, status, total, created_at). Export mockExpenses (10 entries: Rent, Salaries, Electricity, Water, Stationery, Transport, Maintenance, Advertising categories). Export mockSettings object {shop_name: 'AgroVet POS', shop_address: '12 Market Road, Kano', shop_phone: '0801 234 5678', currency: 'N', receipt_footer: 'Thank you for your business!', receipt_counter: '15'}. Export mockUsers (3 entries: admin demo-admin, manager demo-manager, cashier demo-cashier).

Write src/store/authStore.js using zustand create(). State: user (null), session (null), role (null), loading (true), profile (null). initialize() action: if useMock set user={id:'demo-admin',email:'admin@demo.com'}, profile={full_name:'Demo Admin',role:'admin'}, role='admin', loading=false and return; else call supabase.auth.getSession(), on session fetch profile from profiles table, subscribe to onAuthStateChange. login(email, password) action: if useMock set demo user state and return {error:null}; else call supabase.auth.signInWithPassword(). logout() action: if useMock reset state; else supabase.auth.signOut(). Export useAuthStore.

Write src/store/posStore.js using zustand create(). State: items (empty array), customer (''), paymentMethod ('Cash'), discount (0), discountType ('percent'). addItem(product): if item already in cart increment qty by 1, else push {id:product.id, product, qty:1, overridePrice:null}. removeItem(id): filter out. updateQty(id, qty): if qty<1 remove, else update. setOverridePrice(id, price): update item.overridePrice. setDiscount(value, type): update discount and discountType. setCustomer(name): update customer. setPaymentMethod(method): update paymentMethod. clearCart(): reset all. getSubtotal(): computed sum of items (overridePrice ?? selling_price) * qty. getDiscountAmount(): if type=percent: subtotal*discount/100, else discount. getTotal(): subtotal - discountAmount. Export usePosStore.

If allowedRoles prop provided and role not in allowedRoles return Navigate to='/dashboard' replace. Otherwise return children.

findings: 1. npm install requires --legacy-peer-deps due to vite@5.0.8 peer resolution conflict with @vitejs/plugin-react@4.2.1. FEAT-002/003/004 must use the same flag or the lock file already handles it after first install. 2. BrowserRouter is imported in main.jsx; App.jsx uses Routes/Route only — do not add a second BrowserRouter in any later feature. 3. useMock=true whenever VITE_SUPABASE_URL is absent or equals 'your-supabase-url'; no .env file needed in CI. 4. mockProducts IDs are stable strings (prod-001 … prod-025); mockSales reference these IDs in mockSaleItems — keep them stable across FEAT-002/003/004 to avoid broken joins. 5. The POS page mounts its own layout (.pos-layout) that fills the full viewport height minus the 52px navbar; it must NOT be wrapped in an extra padding container by AppShell — page-content already has padding:1.25rem so POS overrides that with negative margin or the pos-layout height must account for it. 6. Receipt counter in mock is a string '15'; increment logic is in POS.jsx (local var). Real counter must come from Supabase in live mode. 7. All 11 routes are wired in App.jsx behind ProtectedRoute/AppShell; FEAT-002/003/004 only need to flesh out the page components — routing is done.
